text:
GitHub in Slack and Teams: a bug report can become a reviewable pull request.

The Nov. 6 release makes @GitHub generally available in both apps. It can investigate a bug, create an issue, implement a change and open a PR from the conversation. Teams Canvas also brings plans, code changes and previews alongside the discussion.

The builder value isn't replacing the conversation. It's giving that conversation a concrete next artifact.

Try this week: use a test repository and one reproducible bug. Supply expected behavior and reproduction steps. Ask for the smallest proposed fix and a regression test. Inspect the diff and test result before a human decides to merge.

Our Tech Thursday image experiment is the counterweight: Copilot CLI connected through MCP and generated a batch, but the host wasn't satisfied with its look. Execution alone didn't make it right.

AI is moving into workflows. Your acceptance rule has to move with it.

Source: GitHub Changelog, Nov. 6, 2026
https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-06-github-copilot-in-slack-and-teams-is-generally-available/

Save this for your next chat-to-code handoff.
